module_summary: Multi-cycle IEEE-754 single-precision multiplier sequenced by a free-running 3-bit phase counter: unpack, special cases, normalize, multiply mantissas, round, pack into z.

anchors.name: counter
anchors.why: Phase counter sequencing unpack, special-case, normalize, multiply, round and pack steps.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: First IEEE-754 operand unpacked into sign, exponent, mantissa.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Second IEEE-754 operand unpacked into sign, exponent, mantissa.

anchors.name: product
anchors.why: Mantissa product feeding result mantissa and guard/round/sticky bits.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Packed IEEE-754 result, or NaN/Inf/zero special-case value.

anchors.name: a_mantissa
anchors.why: Operand mantissa held and normalized across phases; b_mantissa is its twin.

anchors.name: a_exponent
anchors.why: Unbiased operand exponent held, adjusted on denormal/normalize; b_exponent twin.

anchors.name: z_mantissa
anchors.why: Result mantissa normalized and rounded before packing into z.

anchors.name: z_exponent
anchors.why: Result exponent sum, adjusted for underflow/normalize/round, checked for overflow.

anchors.name: a_sign
anchors.why: Operand sign bit held; b_sign is its twin.

anchors.name: z_sign
anchors.why: Result sign, XOR of operand signs, packed into z[31].

anchors.name: guard_bit
anchors.why: Guard bit with round/sticky deciding round-up of z_mantissa.

groups.name: phase_sequencer
groups.description: Free-running counter selecting which computation phase executes.

groups.name: operand_unpack
groups.description: Unpacks, denormalizes and normalizes operand fields.

groups.name: mantissa_multiply
groups.description: Multiplies mantissas, adds exponents, XORs signs.

groups.name: round_normalize
groups.description: Normalizes and rounds result using guard/round/sticky bits.

groups.name: result_pack
groups.description: Packs result or special-case value into IEEE-754 z.
